Under the UCC sales rules, Costco's order confirmation operated as an acceptance even though it added the loading charge, and between merchants that added term is treated as a proposal that becomes part of the contract unless it materially alters the agreement or is objected to. A loading charge of $50 per thousand envelopes likely materially alters the contract, so it would not automatically become part of the deal, but a binding contract still exists on Rainmaking's original terms. Thus a court would likely find a contract formed without the loading charge included.
CONFIDENCE: 80
